description: Browse, test and compare fonts and icon fonts: Google Fonts, Font Awesome and more, local font files, web fonts and system fonts, on a Bootstrap-style typography page.
configuration.sampleText: Default sample text used in the preview.
configuration.catalogUrl: URL of the Fontsource font list used as the Google Fonts catalog.
configuration.showStatusBarItem: Show a status bar button that opens the Font Preview.
configuration.projectFontFolder: Workspace folder that "Add to project" downloads fonts into. Each font gets its own subfolder with a stylesheet.
